image_description: A close-up, low-angle view of a modern staircase featuring a metal bannister system. The handrail is a sleek, tubular metal bar running diagonally upwards. It is supported by thin vertical metal balusters and a secondary horizontal railing structure. To the left, dark wooden structural beams or supports are visible, contrasting with the silver/grey metal of the railing. The steps appear to be made of light-colored stone or concrete. The lighting is somewhat dim with cool blue tones.
